signals.detail: HY spreads widening to 329bps with the S&P still up 0.6% on the month. Credit markets price default and financing risk more directly, which makes this divergence a useful independent warning rather than confirmation.
signals.title: Credit widening while equities hold

signals.detail: NFCI at -0.50 and tightening while Growth still reads Steady. Financial conditions lead activity, so this is the sequence that precedes a growth downgrade rather than confirming one.
signals.title: Conditions tightening ahead of growth
